YOUTUBE PLAYABLE TEMPLATE, COMMON RULES. First script in index.html: <script src="https://www.youtube.com/game_api/v1"></script>. Wrap ytgame in a platform module with stubs so it runs without the SDK: firstFrameReady after first frame, gameReady once when Title accepts input, sendScore({value:int}) on Result, loadData/saveData JSON {"v":1,"best":0,"runs":0,"progress":{}}, onPause = freeze + silence + save, onResume = stay Paused, isAudioEnabled/onAudioEnabledChange drive master gain (no mute button), errors -> health.logError. No network, fonts, images, audio files, localStorage. All values in game_spec.json (stage units, seconds, palette tokens). Canvas fills window, stage 720x1280 fit contain, DPR cap 2, works 9:32 to 32:9, HUD anchored to screen edges + safe area: score top-left, timer top-center, pause top-right. Fixed 1/60 step, pools, no allocation in loop. States BOOT, TITLE, PLAY, PAUSED, RESULT. Input = actions from keys AND Pointer Events (tap, hold, swipe, drag, zones, joystick), same actions on keyboard and touch, buttons reachable by Enter/Space and Escape/P, touch-action none. Flat primitives, palette bg #121318 surface #1E2028 line #343846 text #F4F5F7 player #4CC9F0 hazard #F25F5C pickup #FFD166 positive #06D6A0 special #B388FF neutral #7D8597, system-ui font. Synth Web Audio sfx: uiTap start collect hit destroy action powerup win lose. Modules: spec platform viewport input audio save pool draw ui game world systems skins (skins read only look).

GAME: BOUNCE AND BREAK (brick breaker). Stage 720x1280 fit contain, fixed camera. Put these sections in game_spec.json:
{"meta":{"id":"bounce-break","title":"Bounce and Break","version":"0.1.0","archetype":"bounce-break","scoreLabel":"Score"},"input":{"bindings":{"left":{"keys":["ArrowLeft","KeyA"],"pointer":[]},"right":{"keys":["ArrowRight","KeyD"],"pointer":[]},"moveTo":{"keys":[],"pointer":"drag"},"launch":{"keys":["Space","ArrowUp","KeyW"],"pointer":"tap"}},"mouseFollow":true},"rules":{"lives":3,"fieldTop":140,"maxBounceAngle":60,"launchAngle":20,"minVerticalRatio":0.3,"substepMaxMove":7,"powerupDropChance":0.12,"lifeBonus":500,"levelClearDelay":1.2},"player":{"y":1140,"width":160,"height":28,"speed":1100,"maxWidth":320,"look":{"shape":"roundRect","color":"player","w":160,"h":28}},"entities":[{"id":"ball","kind":"ball","radius":14,"look":{"shape":"circle","color":"text","size":28}},{"id":"basic","kind":"block","symbol":"1","hp":1,"points":10,"look":{"shape":"rect","color":"neutral","w":80,"h":36}},{"id":"tough","kind":"block","symbol":"2","hp":2,"points":25,"look":{"shape":"rect","color":"pickup","w":80,"h":36}},{"id":"hard","kind":"block","symbol":"3","hp":3,"points":50,"look":{"shape":"rect","color":"hazard","w":80,"h":36}},{"id":"steel","kind":"block","symbol":"S","hp":0,"points":0,"look":{"shape":"rect","color":"line","w":80,"h":36}},{"id":"bonus","kind":"block","symbol":"P","hp":1,"points":20,"dropChance":1,"look":{"shape":"rect","color":"special","w":80,"h":36}},{"id":"wide","kind":"powerup","effect":"widePaddle","value":1.5,"duration":10,"weight":3,"fallSpeed":260,"look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"special","size":48}},{"id":"multi","kind":"powerup","effect":"multiBall","value":2,"duration":0,"weight":2,"fallSpeed":260,"look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"positive","size":48}},{"id":"slow","kind":"powerup","effect":"slowBall","value":0.7,"duration":8,"weight":2,"fallSpeed":260,"look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"player","size":48}}]}

FIELD
Walls left, right and top (rules.fieldTop), no bottom wall, pre-rendered line strokes. Block grid: 8 columns, blocks 80x36, gap 6, top row y 220, centered. For now one level with rows "11111111","11111111","1P1111P1","11111111"; symbol -> block entity with that symbol, "." = empty.

PADDLE
Rect player.width x player.height at (x, player.y), clamped inside the walls. left/right keys move it at player.speed; moveTo (drag, and plain mouse move if input.mouseFollow) sets its center x to the pointer x. A drag is never a launch.

BALL
Serve: the ball rests on the paddle and follows it; launch sends it at rules.launchAngle degrees from vertical, random side. Speed 700 u/s for now, re-applied each step to the current direction.
Paddle bounce, only when moving down and overlapping: offset = clamp((ball.x - paddle.x)/(paddleWidth/2), -1, 1), angle = offset * rules.maxBounceAngle from vertical, direction = (sin, -cos), ball placed above the paddle.
Walls reflect vx (sides) or vy (top) and push the ball inside. After any bounce, if |dir.y| < rules.minVerticalRatio set it to that value keeping its sign and re-normalize.

COLLISIONS (no tunneling)
Move each ball in n = ceil(speed*dt / rules.substepMaxMove) substeps. Per substep test walls, paddle, then only blocks in the 3x3 cells around the ball. Circle vs AABB: reflect on the axis of least penetration (both axes if penetrations are within 2 u: corner), push out, stop testing blocks for that substep.

BLOCKS
Hit: hp -= 1, flash. hp 0: destroyed, score += points, particles. Defined hp 0 = indestructible, not needed to clear. No destructible block left = level cleared (for now RESULT win).

LIVES
A ball below y 1280+radius is lost (back to pool). No ball left: lose a life, new serve; 0 lives: RESULT lose. sendScore(score).

Systems in order each step: input, paddle, ball (substeps + collisions), blocks, lives, level. Skins: drawPaddle, drawBall, drawBlock reading only look. Check: 3 min of play, no tunneling, paddle OK with keys, mouse, touch.
